text:
anna: Heads up — we’re releasing Private Agent v2.3.0 next Tue 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC. Includes a kernel/networking stack update and a small agent-side NAT fix. Short checklist below, pls ack if you own any customer comms. :mega:

samir: Quick q — is this rolling per-tenant or global? Any expected data-plane interruption?

anna: Rolling per-tenant. Control-plane ops may see 1–2m disruption for a tenant while we swap the agent, data-plane should remain connected in most cases. Customers using corporate proxies/NAT-traversal may see connection resets until proxy rules are adjusted.

maya: Oncall: we’ll run smoke tests and keep a rollback window. If we hit >5% 5xx or control-plane p95 >200ms, we roll back. Runbook link: https://go/release-private-agent-v2.3.0 (internal)

jamie: SE note — customers must allow outbound to agents.redwood.internal:8443 during the window. Also remind them to whitelist the new agent binary signature if they do binary allowlisting. I’ll draft the email.

legal-bot: Compliance check: no customer payloads will be uplinked to Redwood during the kernel update. Agent-local traces (opt-in telemetry) will note upgrade timestamps only. Any customer asking for logs should be routed to support with the minimal bundle template.

samir: Healthcheck snippet for ops teams: 
````
curl -sSf -X GET https://localhost:8443/health | jq .
````

anna: PMs / SEs — please confirm high-risk customers (restricted networks, proxy-only egress) by EOD Fri so we can schedule a manual coordination slot. :eyes:

jamie: I’ll run a query for customers with restricted egress and DM the list. Draft email template ready at https://go/templates/agent-upgrade-announce — will adapt per region.

maya: Oncall schedule: I’ll be live in #eng-oncall during the rollout. Ops will trigger fallback routing to Dedicated if necessary.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for Tue 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC — pending approval from Anna and VP Infra.

anna: Approved. Adding a short FAQ to the release notes about proxy changes and firewall ports. :rocket:

samir: Adding changelog entry about manual proxy steps + troubleshooting checklist.

jamie: Customer-facing comms: subject line suggestion — "Planned agent update: improved NAT handling; brief connectivity check requested". Template includes step-by-step firewall check.

maya: If anything goes sideways we’ll capture an incident stub and use the standard postmortem template. I’ll create the stub now so it’s ready.

anna: Thanks everyone — expect a final reminder 24h before the window. Reply here if you need to join the pre-roll coordination call.
